ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Leads getting created with Status only as New. Manual update of Leads are not allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', !ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT(Skip_Validations__c = 'ConvertLead'), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead Status cannot be updated manually. Please Log A Response to update Lead Status.
